title: China Toy Atlas
scope: Chinese blind-box and squishy brands; mainland availability is verified separately from international listings.

methodology.coverage: This is a growing source-backed directory, not a census of every SKU sold in China. International listings show product identification and source-market prices, not proof of mainland availability or mainland price.
methodology.dates: Launch dates require explicit release evidence. Store published_at is retained only as retailer listing date. First seen is the directory discovery date. Restocks do not become new launches.
methodology.sales: No sales estimates. Product units sold require a product-level source, channel and period. Reviews, stock quantities, gross merchandise value and brand revenues are never counted as units sold.
methodology.waves: A wave number is recorded only where the source explicitly names a series, volume or generation. Series titles remain intact; no invented chronological wave numbering.
methodology.images: Product photographs come from the linked product listing. No generated images, logos substituted for products, or unrelated placeholders.
methodology.price: Keep currency, market, variant, pack size and retailer with each price. China launch RRP and current asking price are separate. A listed price is not proof of a completed transaction.
methodology.weekly: Automated source refresh every Monday at 08:30 China time. Newly discovered products, new verified launches, price changes and restocks are separately identified. Initial imports are marked baseline, not new launches.
